mapper.select: SELECT /* LGUTLC00130.retrieveMailTemplateContentsData */ a.mail_id , a.language_code , a.subject_text , a.mail_detail_content , a.etc_attach_file_id , b.file_id , b.file_name , b.file_desc FROM LGCOM_MAIL_CONTENT_N a , LGCOM_ATTACH_FILE_INFO b WHERE a.mail_id = #{mailId} AND a.language_code = #{languageCode} AND a.etc_attach_file_id = b.file_group_id(+)
mapper.update: MERGE INTO /* LGUTLC00130.saveMailTemplateContentsData */ LGCOM_MAIL_CONTENT_N a USING (SELECT #{mailId} AS mail_id , #{languageCode} AS language_code , #{subjectText} AS subject_text , #{mailDetailContent,jdbcType=CLOB} AS mail_detail_content , #{etcAttachFileId} AS etc_attach_file_id , #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} AS user_id FROM DUAL ) b ON (a.mail_id = b.mail_id AND a.language_code = b.language_code) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT(mail_id,language_code,subject_text,mail_detail_content,etc_attach_file_id, created_by,creation_date,last_updated_by,last_update_date) VALUES(b.mail_id,b.language_code,b.subject_text,b.mail_detail_content,b.etc_attach_file_id, b.user_id,SYSDATE,b.user_id,SYSDATE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET subject_text = b.subject_text , mail_detail_content = b.mail_detail_content , etc_attach_file_id = b.etc_attach_file_id , last_updated_by = b.user_id , last_update_date = SYSDATE
mapper.select: SELECT /* LGUTLC00130.retrieveMailTemplateTextRecipientList */ mrn.mail_id , mrn.mail_recipient_type_code , mrn.mail_recipient_addr , mrn.mail_type_code FROM LGCOM_MAIL_RECIPIENT_N mrn , ( SELECT common_code , sort_order_no FROM LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_C WHERE code_type_code = 'LGCOM_RECIPIENT_TYPE_CODE' AND use_flag = 'Y' AND (apply_start_date IS NULL OR apply_start_date <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND (apply_end_date IS NULL OR apply_end_date >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) ) cd WHERE mrn.mail_id = #{mailId} AND mrn.mail_recipient_type_code = cd.common_code(+) ORDER BY cd.sort_order_no,mrn.mail_recipient_type_code, mrn.mail_recipient_addr, mrn.mail_type_code

SELECT /* LGUTLC00130.retrieveMailTemplateSqlRecipientList */ mrn.mail_id , mrn.mail_recipient_type_code , mrn.mail_seq_no , mrn.mail_type_code , mrn.sql_text , mrn.from_sql_text , mrn.where_sql_text , mrn.rule_sql_text FROM LGCOM_MAIL_RECIPIENT_QUERY_N mrn , ( SELECT common_code , sort_order_no FROM LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_C WHERE code_type_code = 'LGCOM_RECIPIENT_TYPE_CODE' AND use_flag = 'Y' AND (apply_start_date IS NULL OR apply_start_date <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND (apply_end_date IS NULL OR apply_end_date >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) ) cd WHERE mrn.mail_id = #{mailId} AND mrn.mail_recipient_type_code = cd.common_code(+) ORDER BY cd.sort_order_no,mrn.mail_recipient_type_code, mrn.mail_seq_no
mapper.update: MERGE INTO /* LGUTLC00130.saveMailTemplateSqlRecipientData */ LGCOM_MAIL_RECIPIENT_QUERY_N a USING ( SELECT #{mailId} AS mail_id , #{mailRecipientTypeCode} AS mail_recipient_type_code , #{mailSeqNo} AS mail_seq_no , #{mailTypeCode} AS mail_type_code , #{sqlText} AS sql_text , #{fromSqlText} AS from_sql_text , #{whereSqlText} AS where_sql_text , #{ruleSqlText} AS rule_sql_text , #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} AS user_id FROM DUAL ) b ON (a.mail_id = b.mail_id AND a.mail_recipient_type_code = b.mail_recipient_type_code AND a.mail_seq_no = b.mail_seq_no) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET mail_type_code = b.mail_type_code , sql_text = b.sql_text , from_sql_text = b.from_sql_text , where_sql_text = b.where_sql_text , rule_sql_text = b.rule_sql_text , last_updated_by = b.user_id , last_update_date = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT(mail_id,mail_recipient_type_code,mail_seq_no,mail_type_code,sql_text,from_sql_text, where_sql_text,rule_sql_text,created_by,creation_date,last_updated_by,last_update_date) VALUES(b.mail_id,b.mail_recipient_type_code,(SELECT NVL(MAX(mail_seq_no),0) + 1 FROM LGCOM_MAIL_RECIPIENT_QUERY_N WHERE mail_id = b.mail_id), b.mail_type_code,b.sql_text,b.from_sql_text, b.where_sql_text,b.rule_sql_text,b.user_id,SYSDATE,b.user_id,SYSDATE)
